ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-grey pixels occupy approximately 82% of the visible surface area, contrasted against low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels concentrated at the peduncle junction and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous field across the central and outer lobes. A large, irregular dark-intensity region is mapped at the lower central junction (peduncle area). Fine, low-density dark mottling is localized along the lower boundary of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (jagged serrations) are detected along the distal 50% of the right lobe trailing edge. The left lobe trailing edge displays lower-frequency, smoother topography until the submerged region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe exhibits a strong convex curve originating from the center, tapering toward an acute distal point. The left lobe displays a corresponding convex trajectory before the lower boundary is occluded by water.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of irregular, high-contrast, raised-texture pixels (white on dark and white on white) are visible on the distal-most tip of the left lobe and along the upper leading edge of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detected as thin, dark-intensity linear pixel streaks oriented diagonally across the mid-section of the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular jaggedness and physical material loss on the right trailing edge; dense calcified clusters (barnacle scars) on the outer leading edges.
